china-1925-6:p1024_1.rationale: Lists local taels by place with silver content in grains and values relative to Kuping and Tsaoping taels. This is a monetary-unit equivalence table, so measurement-and-units fits; currency covers the monetary standards.

china-1925-6:p1026_1.rationale: Gives annual Haikwan tael equivalents in English, American, French, German, Indian, Japanese, Russian and Mexican money, 1914-1924. These are exchange values.

china-1925-6:p1027_1.rationale: Shows approximate equivalences between Kuping, Haikwan and local taels at each port. This is a monetary-unit conversion table.

china-1925-6:p1039_1.rationale: Itemised daily cost of coining dollars at the Nanking mint, covering bullion, coal, wages, interest and other costs. It is an operating cost account. No existing tag fits mint operations.
review_questions: Propose a tag for mints and coinage operations.

china-1925-6:p1040_1.rationale: Lists foreign banks in China with establishment year, head office, branches and authorized and paid-up capital.

china-1925-6:p1043_1.rationale: Continuation of the list of foreign banks, giving establishment year, head office and Chinese branches.

china-1925-6:p1043_2.rationale: Capital columns of the foreign banks list, giving authorized and paid-up capital with branch locations.
review_questions: Row-to-bank alignment is uncertain for two banks.

china-1925-6:p1044_1.rationale: Final two entries of the foreign banks list, with founding year, head office, branches and capital.

china-1925-6:p1047_1.rationale: Lists Japanese banks in China with establishment dates, head offices, branches and yen capital.

china-1925-6:p1063_1.rationale: Receipts and disbursements of the Shanghai mint when it was wound up, covering bond proceeds, land, buildings, machinery and the cash balance. It is a financial account. No existing tag fits mint accounts.
review_questions: Propose a tag for mints and coinage operations.
